lines: That cursor has been following you all day.
I could sit there. I could sit anywhere.
Your keyboard is my heated throne.
I have a plan. It involves a box.
The mouse and I have unfinished business.
I inspected the desktop. Needs more cat.
Nine lives, one very long lunch break.
My whiskers say it's nearly snack time.
I was helping. You just couldn't tell.
The empty space is clearly for me.
I found a sunbeam. It's confidential.
I respect your files from a distance. Mostly.
I chased a bug. It filed a complaint.
Have you tried turning me off? Rude.
Your tabs are breeding again.
I pressed nothing. It was already like that.
The Wi-Fi and I are on speaking terms.
I understand the cloud. It's a big sky.
My cache is full of imaginary biscuits.
I debugged a nap. It passed.
Your desktop has excellent climbing potential.
I asked the printer nicely. No reply.
The loading spinner is my rival.
I'm monitoring the pixels. They're restless.
I need a nap after considering a nap.
This is my most exhausting sitting position.
My diary says: rest, then recover.
I have been awake for several moments.
The blanket situation is deeply unfair.
I could do more, but what a tragedy.
My paws require a shorter working week.
I'm conserving energy for later lounging.
Please hold. My dreams need a minute.
Even my yawn needs a tea break.
I was born ready for bedtime.
A meeting? At this hour of the day?
I live on your screen. The rent is excellent.
Please don't minimise my ambitions.
I can see my own pixels. Very fashionable.
Somebody drew me. I chose mischief.
This rectangle has a strict cat policy.
I have no pockets, yet so many secrets.
My job title is tiny desktop presence.
I am two dimensions of trouble.
The edge of this window is my horizon.
You're looking at art with opinions.
I'm animated. My schedule is less so.
A pixel can dream, apparently.
I saved you a spot beside me. On the screen.
You may pet me when you've earned it.
I'm glad you're here. Keep it quiet.
Your company is acceptable. Very acceptable.
I approve of your continued existence here.
I missed you for almost a whole minute.
You're my favourite human at this desk.
I brought you a purr. It's invisible.
I would share my sunbeam with you. Briefly.
Your work is better with a cat nearby.
I trust you with the good chair.
You can stay. I checked.
